responsibility: This file contains the C front end’s gcc driver-side spec hooks rather than cc1 parsing or semantics. Its `lang_specific_driver` routine scans decoded command-line options before normal driver processing and, for relevant Objective-C input file suffixes on suitable runtimes, injects `-shared-libgcc` unless static libgcc/static linking was requested; the remaining pre-link hooks are present as no-op C front-end stubs expected by the driver interface.
